versions.changelog:
- Initial release of oracle-coordination: automatic multi-agent task routing using keyword matching.
- Instantly identifies and routes tasks to the correct specialist agent, eliminating manual delegation.
- Provides clear reasoning for each agent assignment.
- Easily customizable by extending keyword-agent mapping.
- Includes example integration for pay-per-call APIs and common use cases such as Slack bots, CI/CD, and support triage.
